Live Cold Risk · IMD + Open-Meteo

Abhi ki sthiti: koi cold wave sakriya nahi

Cold wave ka season aam taur par December–January me aata hai. October ke aakhir me IMD ki koi cold-wave chetaavni jaari nahi hai (25 Oct 2026 ko dobara check kiya gaya) — ye panel wahi dikhata hai jo sach hai, nakli alert nahi banata. Har 5 minute me ye view dobara scan hota hai.

Cold wave hoti kab hai? (IMD ke niyam)

  • Maidan (plains): kam-se-kam tapmaan ≤ 10°C aur aam se 4.5–6.4°C neeche — ya asal kam-se-kam tapmaan ≤ 4°C.
  • Severe cold wave: aam se ≥ 6.5°C neeche, ya kam-se-kam tapmaan ≤ 2°C.
  • Pahad (hills): kam-se-kam tapmaan ≤ 0°C par cold-wave sthiti.
  • Cold wave ki ghoshna sirf IMD karta hai — ye site apni taraf se koi "live cold wave" declare nahi karti.

Aaj raat sabse thandi jagahen — forecast ranking

Raat 25–26 Oct 2026 ke liye Open-Meteo model forecast, sabse thandi pehle. Ye anumaan hai, naapa gaya tapmaan nahi — pahadi jilon me model ka ankda asal se 2–3°C idhar-udhar ho sakta hai. Kisi card par tap karne se wo jagah neeche globe/map par khulegi.

Thand Map · Forecast Spots

Map: aaj raat ki thand kahan sabse tez?

Dono views ke kaam alag hain. 3D Thand Globe (default) sirf LIVE layer dikhata hai — aaj raat ki forecast jagahen; purane records globe par kabhi nahi aate. 2D Map par wahi forecast gole aur saare 34 verified purane spell records (chhote halke-neele gole) dikhte hain. Forecast gola tap karo — uska barf-badal khulega (anumaan, haal, dono route); record gola tap karo — poora spell record khulega. Ye forecast hai, live cold wave nahi.

Map par dikhao:
Dot guide — asaan bhasha me
DHYAAN DO — gehra neela gola: tapmaan 0°C ke paas ya neeche. Paani jam sakta hai, sadak par kaala barf.
DHYAAN DO — neela gola: kadake ki thand (≤ 5°C). Garam kapde, kambal zaroori.
IGNORE — halka gola: sirf tulna ke liye hai, yahan thand ka koi khatra nahi.
RECORD (sirf 2D map par) — chhota halka-neela gola: purana verified spell. Tap karo, poora record khulega.

Thand Se Bachav · Safety

Sheet lehar me khud ko aur dusron ko bachao

Archive ka sabse dukhad pattern: marne walon me sabse zyada beghar, footpath par sone wale, buzurg aur mazdoor hain. Thand me madad aksar ek kambal aur ek phone call se shuru hoti hai.

Parat-dar-parat garam kapde

Ek moti jacket se behtar hai 2–3 parat. Sir, kaan, haath-pair dhako — sharir ki garmi sabse zyada wahin se nikalti hai. Geelay kapde turant badlo.

Angithi ka zehar — sabse chhupa khatra

Band kamre me angithi/koyla kabhi mat jalao — carbon monoxide bina boo ke maar deta hai. Jalana hi pade to khidki khuli rakho, sone se pehle bujha do.

Hypothermia pehchano

Tez kaanpna, ladkhadahat, uljhi hui baatein, thandi safed chamdi — ye sanket dikhe to garam jagah le jao, kambal odhao, garam meetha paani do aur 112 par call karo.

Kohra (fog) me sadak suraksha

Archive ke 4 records kohre ke accidents ke hain. Kohre me raftaar aadhi, fog light on, achanak brake kabhi nahi. Dikhna band ho to surakshit jagah ruk jao.

Aas-paas walon ka khayal

Footpath par sota koi dikhe to use paas ke rain basera (night shelter) ki taraf bhejo ya sthaniya nagar nigam helpline par suchna do. Ek purana kambal kisi ki raat bacha sakta hai.

Buzurg aur bimaar log

Thand me BP aur dil ka dabav badhta hai. Buzurgon ko subah ki tez thand me sair se roko, dawaai samay par, aur kamra band karke heater ke saath sone se bacho.

112National Emergency — police, ambulance, koi bhi aapaat sthiti. Hypothermia ya behoshi dikhe to yahi number. 101Fire Brigade — angithi/aag lag jaye ya dhuaan bhar jaye to. Thand ke mausam me aag ki ghatnayein badh jati hain.

India Cold Wave Explorer — sirf cold wave (sheet lehar) ke liye bani ek standalone website. Archive: 34 source-verified cold spells, 2003–2023, har record ke saath uska source. Live layer: IMD cold-wave sthiti + Open-Meteo model forecast (25 Oct 2026 ko dobara jaancha gaya snapshot), har jagah forecast ko forecast hi likha gaya hai.

Ek imaandar seema: thand se hui maut India ka sabse kam-documented disaster toll hai — sarkar iska koi central register rakhti hi nahi. Jo verify nahi hua, wo is site par nahi hai.
